3. Consider the sound and rhythm of the name: Say the name out loud and see how it flows with your last name. You may also want to consider how the name will sound when paired with any siblings' names.

4. Think about potential nicknames: Consider if the name has any common nicknames that you like or dislike, as your child may be called by a shortened version of their name.

5. Consult with your partner or loved ones: It can be helpful to get input from your partner or loved ones on potential baby names to ensure that everyone is happy with the choice.
